full_page.content:
1935, June
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 4 Cont.
June 6 Geneve LaRose - 20 - almost blind - lost her father last November, Mother struggling to support her and sister 17.
Gold ring found in Church. .
Laverne Korth - 12 - fractured skull at 16 mo. old - fell two flights - only at 8 yrs. began to talk Enrolled (50¢)
Russell Yound - N.C. - 42 - apend. oper'n successful, now blood-clots
7 Mrs. Mary E. Kaltz - 64 - fearfully helpless now coming four yrs. Husband has to lift her and care for as a little child ....
8 Alger Gracy - once a methodist - of Smith's Creek - almost deaf since about 12.
Page 5 June 8 Edw'd DePue - 25 To-day - ecema & Surisis ..... since 12 yrs. old ... Mrs. Mary Lafferty - 65 - losing weight from 165 to 104 - gall bl. & diabetis.
9
John E. Dee - 50 - high bl. pressure - stroke feared .....
Frank Morino - middle age - earnestly asks prayers for his perseverence against a tempter who has succeeded more than once in drawing him from the path of duty & virtue.
Mrs. Capieto wants day work so as to be home with three small boys at night.
10 Mrs. Vanunkel. .... one breast lost three months ago - Today the other. Van Hees - Want to get out of beer garden - wants to sell out .....
Page 6 June 11 Mrs. Cha's Verhaeven of Monroe - 52 - losing sight .... Mother 87 fell last week intending to come her for services . leg broken & hip dis- located - Stroke feared.
Mrs. Magd. Blume Kesler - 60 - cataracts .... son cured .. from Epilepsy John & Robert Evans - Episcopelian - 6 & 3 - neither can talk - one crippled.
